questions.question: Tazmin Brits set a database record (22/23 season, List A) with a value of 478. Which record is it?
options: Best Bowling Figures in an Innings
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Runs', held by Tazmin Brits.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Alicia Smith or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Alicia Smith: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: At Willowmoore Park Main Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Dragons?
Which team has finished runner-up more times than any other in this database (7), despite winning the title only twice in that span?
questions.explanation: Lions finished runner-up 7 times across List A and T20 Division 1 between 2012/13 and 2025/26, but won the title only twice.

questions.question: At which ground did Selaelo Mphahele record their career-best innings (26, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/06.
